rows.label: Show Russian proficiency: intermediate Russian composition, or the heritage or advanced route if you placed out

source.anchor: Language Requirement for the Russian Minor

rows.note: Counts RUSSA 2204, or RUSSA 3305 / 3306 for students who placed out of it, when taken as a course (placement or exam credit for 2204 does not count here). The board cannot see placement, so the placement row asks you to confirm it.

rows.label: If using placement, or a Russian language course taken abroad or in a summer program, confirm it reaches the same proficiency level

source.anchor: Language Requirement for the Russian Minor

rows.note: Placing out of the intermediate course and outside language courses are judged by the department, not by the board.

rows.label: Take two Russian literature courses (2000 level or above, at least 3 credits each)
rows.note: Counts RUSSL courses only, leaving out supervised reading and Russian Language Program courses (the RUSSA subject). Russian literature taught under other subject codes needs the literature-elsewhere row.

rows.label: Take two more courses (2000 level or above, at least 3 credits each); the board counts further Russian literature courses
rows.note: The page also allows Russia-related courses from other departments, which the board cannot identify; the other-departments row covers those.

rows.label: If using Russia-related courses from other departments for the last two, confirm each is 2000 level or above, 3+ credits and approved as Russia-related
rows.note: Which outside courses are Russia-related is not listed, so the board cannot check them.

rows.label: If a Russian literature course carries another subject code, or is a supervised reading, confirm with the department that it counts
rows.note: The literature pool matches RUSSL courses only and holds out supervised reading and language-program reading courses, so such courses are for you to confirm.

rows.label: Confirm at least one of the four courses includes reading in Russian (language-program reading courses do not count toward the literature part)
rows.note: The catalog data does not show which offerings include Russian-language reading.

rows.label: Make sure the minor adds up to at least 15 credits
Request the application form to declare the minor, and certify completion with the contact professor by week seven of the semester before graduation
